title: Verify exact closing references and recover accidental closure

rubric.text: Requires complete repository-qualified equality after every controller/owner PR create or body edit and immediately before merge; green CI cannot clear mismatch, and automatic CI need not be prevented.

Restores only verified accidental closure with pending work, reads back reopen/Status/comment, respects human changes and unknown prior Status; handles non-closing and non-default-base policies without inventing a closing link. A partial merge retains the open issue, unfinished Status and owner for remaining work instead of terminal cleanup.
